name: mime.multipart
doc:
MIME multipart bodies (RFC 2046, RFC 7578 form-data), as Go's
mime/multipart: a Writer that builds a body part by part, a Reader
that walks the parts of a body, and ReadForm for form submissions.
Parts with Content-Transfer-Encoding: quoted-printable are decoded.

items.name: NewWriter
items.doc: A writer with a random 60-hex-digit boundary.
items.summary: A writer with a random 60-hex-digit boundary.

items.name: ReadForm
items.signature: func ReadForm(body string, boundary string) Form!
items.doc:
Parses a form-data body: fields without a filename are values, the
others files.
items.summary: Parses a form-data body: fields without a filename are values, the others files.
